mapper.select: SELECT a.APPNT_ID, a.EMP_NO, e.EMP_NM, a.APPNT_DT, t.CD_NM AS APPNT_TYPE_NM, bd.DEPT_NM AS BEF_DEPT_NM, ad.DEPT_NM AS AFT_DEPT_NM FROM HR_APPNT a JOIN HR_EMP e ON e.EMP_NO = a.EMP_NO LEFT JOIN CM_CODE t ON t.GRP_CD = 'APPNT' AND t.CD = a.APPNT_TYPE_CD LEFT JOIN HR_DEPT bd ON bd.DEPT_CD = a.BEF_DEPT_CD LEFT JOIN HR_DEPT ad ON ad.DEPT_CD = a.AFT_DEPT_CD WHERE a.APPNT_DT >= #{fromDt} AND a.APPNT_DT <= #{toDt} ORDER BY a.APPNT_DT DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE HR_EMP e JOIN HR_APPNT a ON a.EMP_NO = e.EMP_NO SET e.DEPT_CD = a.AFT_DEPT_CD, e.POS_CD = a.AFT_POS_CD, a.STATUS_CD = '90' WHERE a.APPNT_ID = #{appntId}
mapper.select: SELECT APPNT_ID, EMP_NO FROM ${tableName} WHERE APPNT_DT = #{dt}
